thread:
Ash: heads-up: I'm starting quota + capacity reservation requests for a Dedicated APAC cold-pool for our Q2 perf window. Need quick validation on numbers and who will open support tickets.

Ash: Region = ap-southeast-1 (SG). Primary skus = a100.80gb + a100.40gb as fallback. Proposal: reserve 18 GPUs baseline in prod+perf accounts, with 18 GPU burst runway (on-demand/spot mix). total target = 36 GPUs. Spread across 2 AZs.

Tanya: Confirming this is dedicated capacity (capacity reservations) only for prod + perf; staging stays ephemeral/spot?

Ash: Yup. staging is spot. perf window: 2026-04-12 -> 2026-04-26 (two weeks).

Kai: ops notes: split reservations across AZs to avoid AZ-level caps. recommend reserving 12 now and leaving 24 as burst/on-demand until we see steady utilization. Also, watch ENI consumption during scale tests.

Emily: cost flag: reserved commit that size needs finance signoff. I'll model monthly delta if you paste exact sku mix & expected hours. Tag everything pre-warm with perf-week-2026.

Ash: networking asks: bump ENI per-account -> 180, EIP pool -> 420, and request NAT throughput increase for worker NAT gateways in the VPC. Anyone have the exact quota codes?

Kai: CLI snippets (swap in correct quota codes for our org):
```
# ENI bump
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-ENIXXXX --desired-value 180 --region ap-southeast-1

# EIP bump
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-0263JXQ3 --desired-value 420 --region ap-southeast-1

# GPU instance family quota (if present)
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-GPUFAMXX --desired-value 60 --region ap-southeast-1
```

Tanya: I'll open the EC2 Capacity Reservations support case after we kick off the service-quotas requests. CC'ing @Finance and @Platform-Ops.

quota-bot: Created ticket SUP-102233 for quota requests (ENI=180, EIP=420). SLA: 3 business days. Will update thread.

ops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/capacity-reservations -> see section 'regional cold-pools'. Checklist: update terraform module ec2/dedicated-reservations, tag perf-week-2026, ensure iam role redwood-dedicated-reservation exists, confirm subnet sizing (/22 recommended).

Emily: Plan B if SG quotas are delayed: pre-warm a smaller backup pool in us-west-2 (12 GPUs) and enable cross-region spillover in the smart router. We'll need an inventory tag like region-pref=ap-sg then us-west fallback.

Kai: KMS note: if customers use CMKs, add cross-account KMS allowlist entries before we attach volumes to dedicated nodes. Also set CapacityReservation 'release_on_completion' = false for the perf window so we don't accidentally release.

Ash: Uploaded the provisional cost sheet: https://redwood.internal/docs/perf-week-2026-costs.xlsx. Please review & comment. I'll open service-quotas today and create the capacity reservation ticket.

quota-bot: Update SUP-102233: ENI increase approved for ap-southeast-1. EIP increase pending. EC2 instance-family quota (A100 family) escalated to EC2 team; estimated 2-4 business days.

Tanya: Great. I'll draft the terraform PR template and kick off the finance approval flow. :thumbsup:

Ash: Thanks all — I'll post the support ticket numbers and the terraform PR link here once created. Ping me if you want to join the 11:00 prep sync tomorrow.
